[b]RISING TENSIONS[/b]
At exactly 1:30am on 15th February 2025, the 7th fleet, which consists of 10 HS-B5 battleships and 3 HS-sub2 submarines, departed from Bardaha Harbour. Rising global tensions due to the gendarmite-Arenett war and the Thýren-Norrhollow island crisis have prompted Hydronia to significantly increase its military spending in order to deter any potential hostilities. The 7th fleet has been given orders to patrol Hydronian waters and investigate any suspicious or unauthorised vessels. This includes searching them or, if they are deemed a threat, destroying them. The military has also put all anti-missile and anti-aircraft systems online, as well as putting 6 missile launchers on standby, pointing at number of nations deemed hostile or potentially hostile by the Hydronian Government. The Hydronian government has also reclassified a number of old military records, however they have not made the reason for this apparent.

[b]Austmark is Albic![/b]

The Office for the High Albic Ministry of Foreign Affairs would criticize the "alarmist" language employed by Thýven against the people of High Albany. 

In a statement on the early hours of 16 February 2025, Minister Alice J. Ostman would characterize the actions of the State Defense Acting Quorum as being a [i]"...detriment to the peace and tranquility of the White Sea"[/i], further stating that [i]"... any accusations of Austmark as a forward operating base are born out of a disservice to the good will of the Albic people"[/i], explaining that the occupation and eventual integration of Austmark had been done by the State of Norrhollow with democratic support in order to foster development for its declining fishery sectors due to rapid market globalization.

In response to Thrømm attempts to expand its naval presence in the region, Minister Ostman would pledge to also increase High Albic naval power in the White Sea until "in good time, the Thrømm government acknowledge the rights of High Albany to the island of Austmark, a geological body that exists outside the boundaries of the Thrømm area of responsibility and which has always been considered a cultural artifact of the state of Norrhollow and of all High Albany.

Shortly before departing, Minister Ostman would also lament upon what she sees as a [i]... "visceral decline in Norric-Thrømm relations"[/i], lamenting Thýven ease at accusing its own brothers and sisters of the same blood across the White Sea, while at the same time adopting a conciliatory and even enthusiastic rapport with Shamantine states looking to do business from far across the North Sea.

On the sudden militarization of Hydronia, Ostman would decline to comment, stating that [i]"... what happens in East Shamat does not require the consent or commentary of High Albany."[/i], though she would stress for calm and dialogue.
